name: 70634 · Deridder, LA
findings: ZIP 70634 (Deridder) has 48 nonprofit organizations. 16 of them (33%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 14 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (36% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 70634 (Deridder) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 70634 (Deridder) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 57% of the typical level).
